title: Enforce max_attachments limit on status creation
description: POST /api/v1/statuses accepts 5+ media attachments despite config max_attachments=4. The limit is not enforced during status creation. Should reject with 422 when media_ids.len() > config.limits.max_attachments.
close_reason: Both bugs fixed. max_attachments enforced with 422 rejection. add-to-album accepts string or integer media_id.
